components.name: Token Embedding
components.description: Maps each token ID to a dense vector representation of financial language.

components.name: Positional Encoding
components.description: Injects word position information using sine and cosine functions so the model knows word order.

components.name: Transformer Encoder × 3
components.description: Each block applies multi-head self-attention followed by a feed-forward network with residual connections and layer normalization.

sub_components.name: Multi-Head Self-Attention
sub_components.description: Allows the model to identify relationships between different words regardless of their position within the sentence.

sub_components.name: Add & Layer Normalization
sub_components.description: Residual connection preserves original information while normalization stabilizes training.

sub_components.name: Feed-Forward Network
sub_components.description: Applies non-linear transformations to each token representation independently.

components.name: CLS Pooling
components.description: Extracts the [CLS] token representation which captures the global context of the entire input.

components.name: Classification Head
components.description: Maps the contextual representation to sentiment class probabilities through dense layers with dropout.
